messages:
maria: Heads up — bringing up phoenix-v2-lite (int8) and seeing a consistent loss of polite/honorific suffix preservation in ko->en translations. Quick example below.

kenji: Can you paste the failing examples + metric delta?

maria: Example (input, fp32, int8):

```
input: \"선생님께서는 오셨습니까?\"  // polite/honorific phrasing
fp32 : \"Has the teacher arrived?\"  // preserves polite frame
int8 : \"Teacher came?\"  // blunt, drops honorific wording
```

maria: Small eval summary (subset: politeness-test, ~2k pairs):

```
model         BLEU   chrF   flagged_examples
phoenix-fp32  27.8   0.624  6
phoenix-int8  24.1   0.579  24
delta         -3.7   -0.045  +18
```

tao: Interesting. Could be tokenizer detok/morpho-split or decoder quant noise. Tokenization diff would be first check.

maria: Tokenizer diff shows jamo attachment loss. FP32 tokenization: [\"선생님\", \"께서는\", \"오셨습니까\"]
int8-preproc (same tokenizer binary): [\"선생님\", \"께서\", \"는\", \"오셨습니까\"]  // \"께서는\" split into two tokens after normalization

andre: That looks like a normalization change — not strictly quant. Did the tokenizer or detokenizer version change during the onboard?

maria: I bisected. The tokenizer mapping update in tokenizer v3.2.1 introduced a thin-space normalization that interacts badly with jamo-attachment code path. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/tokenizer/pull/1392 (adds u+2009 normalization)

kenji: So the chain is: new token map -> different token boundaries -> int8 kernels amplify decoder preference -> politeness phrase scored lower -> outputs shorter. Can we repro by forcing fp32 decode on int8 model weights?

maria: Ran that: loading int8 weights but fp32 decode (fallback kernels) gives output much closer to fp32 baseline. So quantized kernels + changed token boundaries jointly cause the regression.

tao: Good repro. Two mitigation paths: 1) pin tokenizer normalization map to previous behavior for ko, or 2) adjust quant kernels (per-channel scaling / calibration) to reduce rank-order noise. I'll try re-quantizing with per-channel scale and symmetric vs asymmetric options.

eval-bot: Quickcheck results uploaded: phoenix-int8-repro-4460001242 
BLEU delta: -3.65, chrF delta: -0.043, flagged: 18/2000 (politeness subset). Artifact: s3://redwood-evals/phoenix/int8/4460001242/report.html

andre: Also run a small beam-size sweep (beam 1/4/8) — quant noise can change beam ranking. If smaller beams recover polite phrase, it's ranking instability not tokenization.

maria: Beam sweep: beam1/4/8 -> polite recall improves slightly at beam8 but still -2.1 BLEU vs fp32. So beam helps but doesn't fully close gap.

kenji: Can we diff token->detok mapping? Maybe detok merges tokens differently after normalization. Put a small script to dump token ids + detok sequence for both tokenizer versions.

maria: Dump attached in repro bundle. Key snippet:

```
# tokenizer v3.1.9
tokens: [0x402, 0x71a3, ...] -> detok: \"선생님께서는\"
# tokenizer v3.2.1
tokens: [0x402, 0x71a3, 0x0112, ...] -> detok: \"선생님께서 는\" -> detok postprocess collapses to \"선생님께서 는\"
```

tao: Looks like a postprocess bug: jamo glue rule accidentally treats u+2009 as separator, producing an extra token boundary. I can try re-quantize after forcing the old normalization table for ko-only. If that restores token boundaries and int8 gives near baseline, we can ship a tokenizer patch.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: started ephemeral job phoenix-int8-repro-4460001260 (patch: tokenizer-v3.1.9-ko-pin)

kenji: Also flag to localization team: if detokenization introduces whitespace inside honorific tokens that can affect other langs (e.g., ja rubies, zh-furigana).

maria: On it. I'll open a small hotfix PR to pin normalization for ko and add a regex unit test: ensures \"께서는\" stays single token.

andre: If hotfix is risky, we can also change quant config as short-term: use per-channel symmetric quant + calibration set with politeness subset. tao, can you run that and post metrics?

tao: Running re-quant with per-channel symmetric now (job started). Will push results here when done.

maria: Thanks. I'll keep the eval artifacts and repro steps in the onboarding ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ML-ONB-774 (notes + links).

kenji: Good investigation. Once we have passing metrics, add a regression test (politeness subset) to ci-onnboard so future tokenizer/normalizer changes fail fast.

maria: Agreed — adding CI test. Will loop back when ops job finishes.

eval-bot: phoenix-int8-repro-4460001260 complete: BLEU delta -0.8, chrF delta -0.009, flagged 4/2000 after tokenizer pin. Artifact: s3://redwood-evals/phoenix/int8/4460001260/report.html

maria: Nice — tokenizer pin + per-channel quant reduced the gap. Will prepare PR to revert global normalizer and add ko-only exception + tests.

andre: Nice work team. Follow-up: add a note to the model onboarding checklist: run politeness/honorific subsets for ko/ja/zh when bringing quantized weights live.

maria: Will do. Closing thread after PR merges. :tada:
